text:
Bielefeld’s median asking rent sits at 10.0 €/m² in June 2026, up 2.9 % year‑on‑year and 24.6 % over the past five years, placing the city 23rd among the 37 most expensive German markets. The asking premium over existing rents is 40 % (7.12 €/m²), while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 600 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 13.3 %.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 1.7 % and an average of 30 days on market; 23 % of listings are let within a week, indicating moderate tightness despite modest population growth of 1.6 % over five years.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 10.5 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 10.24 €/m² and 10.75 €/m², a 5.0 % increase.
